Also excited to announce I'm doing three very cool workshops at the San Miguel Writers' Conference in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico, Feb 2027.

It's going to be a lot of fun and also stunningly gorgeous.Tuition still at a discount for the next few days:

sanmiguelgloballiteraryinstitute.org
Years ago, I ate some tacos al pastor from a cart in San Miguel de Allende one night and they were without any doubt the most amazing tacos I have ever eaten.  I don’t even know the name of the cart.

I suspect it’s in the recycled water systems used for plant irrigation and the soil composting. FYI Not just lettuce. The plant in San Miguel De Allende, State  of Guanajuato Mexico. I think every 2-5 years or so they have to replace or clean the Membrane Bioreactors and they probably don’t test.
Taylor Farms has a facility in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. Which was also the source of a cyclosporosis outbreak in 2013.
